title: Admin panel map
scope: Current checked-out code; no live production/database actions were performed.

nodes.title: Entries
nodes.summary: The review desk for papers imported from flora-extractor. Compare the extracted record, human judgements, and AI result; decide which records belong in the approved validation dataset.
inputs: unvalidated records, validation_queue judgements, record_metadata, skip history, and any existing validated row.
steps: Filter or search the table, then open Review to see the evidence and current decision.
Use Approve for a consensus record, or edit the fields and choose Mark as Resolved.
saves: Approved/resolved values: unvalidated.final_* plus the validated table.
Admin decision history: admin_decisions. Notes: unvalidated.admin_notes, note_saved_by, note_saved_at.
refresh: The Entries list changes after a successful request and refetch.
Approving a validation entry does not rebuild flora.csv: sync_validated.py brings approved records into Source Records during the next FLoRA pipeline; preparation then updates the stored dataset.
outputs: An approved validation row, an excluded row, or a row returned for review.
cautions: Changing fields in the form is not a save.
An admin who judged the record may be prevented from deciding it; the server checks the self-approval policy.
Skip in the admin review modal only moves to the next entry; it is different from a validator recording a skip.

actions.label: Filters, search, sorting, pagination, Review
actions.does: Reads matching entries and their details; no study decision is changed.
actions.when: On fetch.

actions.label: Approve
actions.does: POST /api/admin/entries/{id}/approve accepts the agreed values and marks the entry validated.
actions.saves: unvalidated status/admin fields; validated row; admin_decisions.
actions.when: Entries immediately; FLoRA input after sync_validated, stored output after a successful pipeline.

actions.label: Save Note
actions.does: Saves only the admin note, including who saved it and when. An empty note clears it.
actions.when: After success; visible to all admins when the record reloads. It does not approve or publish the record.

actions.label: Mark as Resolved
actions.does: POST /resolve validates the edited type, original, outcome and evidence; saves the final decision. For reproductions both axes are required.
actions.saves: unvalidated.final_* and admin fields; replaces this record's validated row; admin_decisions.
actions.when: After commit; then downstream sync/preparation is required.

actions.label: Merge duplicate (conflict dialog)
actions.does: If the proposed identity already belongs to another validated record, explicitly keep that survivor and link this duplicate to it.
actions.saves: validated_record_merges; duplicate is rejected in unvalidated, removed from validated, and open assignments completed; survivor preserved.
actions.when: After confirmed resolve succeeds; downstream source retirement is triggered on deletion.

actions.label: It's a replication / It's a reproduction
actions.does: Changes the edit form to the other FLoRA type and shows its fields.
actions.when: Form changes immediately; database only on resolve.

actions.label: Reject — not in FLoRA
actions.does: After confirmation, resolves as not_validation: neither a replication nor a reproduction.
actions.saves: unvalidated becomes rejected; existing validated row removed; decision audit written.
actions.when: Entries immediately; derived FLoRA view follows source retirement; stored release waits for pipeline.

actions.label: Flag for Review / Send back for review
actions.does: Moves an eligible record to need_review. Sending back an auto-validated record also removes its approved row.
actions.saves: unvalidated status/admin note; validated deletion for auto-validated rows; admin_decisions.
actions.when: After success; the validated-source trigger marks its source row deleted at commit.

actions.label: Flag / Unflag a judgement
actions.does: Toggles the flag on one person's submitted judgement. A nonempty reason also creates an inbox message for that validator.
actions.when: Immediately after the request; validator sees the message when their inbox refreshes.

actions.label: Skip → / Cancel
actions.does: Moves to the next entry, or closes the detail window.
actions.saves: No resolution is saved; Save Note is a separate action.
actions.when: Immediately in the browser.

nodes.title: Source Records
nodes.summary: The input ledger: imported entry-sheet records, approved app records, and published disagreement decisions. Open a row to see its provenance; run the FLoRA pipeline here.
inputs: source_records from sync_sources.py, sync_validated.py and adjudication publishing.
steps: Browse imported rows with filters and search; open one to inspect its raw fields and links to derived FLoRA records.
Resolve duplicate imports where necessary.
Run pipeline to ingest, prepare, store and check the complete FLoRA dataset.
saves: Duplicate rulings update source_records and append source_record_edits.
Pipeline queue, log and retained artifacts: source_sync_jobs.
refresh: Source Records grid refetches after a watched run ends.
Pipeline history polls about every 3 seconds while active and visible.
The FLoRA grid reflects source duplicate rulings on rebuild; stored CSV/API update at the next successful pipeline.
outputs: Filtered source CSV; per-run flora.csv plus Markdown/JSON validation reports and full log.
cautions: Source record detail is read-only: correct the derived record in the FLoRA tab.
Export CSV here exports source records, not the prepared public dataset.
Run pipeline does not directly commit a GitHub file. The Publish FLoRA workflow handles the repository copy.

A failed run can occasionally have committed the dataset before a later artifact step failed; inspect the report storage status and recovery artifact rather than assuming that failed means no database changes.

sources.symbol: failed artifact path with committed-storage recovery

actions.label: Filters / Search / Open record / Previous / Next
actions.does: Reads the imported row and follows the current filter queue. Links lead to any derived FLoRA records.
actions.when: On fetch.

actions.label: Export CSV
actions.does: Downloads rows matching the source filters.
actions.saves: A file downloaded by your browser; no database change.
actions.when: At click time.

actions.label: Run pipeline
actions.does: POST /api/admin/source-sync/dispatch queues a server job. A background worker runs the full ingestion/preparation/check sequence.
actions.saves: source_sync_jobs queue/log/artifact fields, source data and prepared dataset during stages.
actions.when: Queued first; output updates when stages succeed. Also scheduled nightly at 03:00 UTC.

actions.label: Refresh
actions.does: Reloads run status/history; it does not launch a run.
actions.saves: No database mutation from this button.
actions.when: On request.

actions.label: History: CSV / report / full log
actions.does: Downloads the chosen run's retained artifact or displays its complete log. Later edits do not rewrite an older run's CSV.
actions.when: The artifact is available once that run produces it.

actions.label: Duplicates → Keep — distinct
actions.does: Records that this input is a separate study and protects it from automatic merging.
actions.saves: source_records duplicate ruling and source_record_edits history.
actions.when: FLoRA grid on next fetch; full CSV/API after pipeline; repository after publication.

actions.label: Duplicates → Duplicate of …
actions.does: Names the surviving source row. A reason is requested; cross-type pairing asks for confirmation.
actions.when: FLoRA grid on next fetch; full CSV/API after pipeline.

actions.label: Show resolved / Back to grid
actions.does: Includes ruled groups for reconsideration, or returns to the source table.
actions.saves: No write until a new ruling is submitted.
actions.when: Immediately in the view.

nodes.title: FLoRA
nodes.summary: The prepared view of the current source records: cleaned identifiers, derived outcomes, exclusions, duplicate decisions and saved corrections. This view can be newer than the stored public release.
inputs: source_records + exclusions + metadata/cache + duplicate rulings + flora_records registry + flora_record_changes.
steps: The service builds a derived view and attaches permanent IDs.
Open a record to correct fields, inspect merged source rows, review checks, or restore a previous correction.
Use Download full CSV for what the public API currently serves; Export filtered CSV for the current tab view.
saves: flora_record_changes stores the correction overlay and complete change history.
For an existing live stored row, field changes also update flora_data and its metadata revision in the same transaction.
Preprint rulings are in preprint_dedup_decisions; checks in flora_check_findings.
refresh: Saving a correction refreshes the grid and the open record.
Existing stored rows get the correction immediately; records not yet stored need the next pipeline. The UI reports which happened.
Duplicate/withdrawal decisions need the next pipeline to change the full stored release.
outputs: Prepared records, current full CSV, filtered view CSV, correction history, findings and preprint decisions.
cautions: Permanent IDs are assigned during pipeline preparation. Filtered export refuses rows without registered IDs.
The source records and Google Sheets stay as imported; corrections are reapplied over them on later builds.
A version conflict reloads the record instead of overwriting another admin's changes.

actions.label: Filters / Search / Refresh / Open record
actions.does: Fetches a current derived view, details, correction history and check findings.
actions.when: On request.

actions.label: Save changes
actions.does: PATCH /api/admin/flora/{id} saves changed fields and per-field notes, guarding the record version.
actions.saves: flora_record_changes; changed published fields in flora_data if a live row exists; flora_data_metadata revision.
actions.when: Grid after success; public API/full CSV immediately for a stored live row, otherwise next pipeline.

actions.label: Revert field to derived value
actions.does: Removes that field's saved override when Save changes is pressed, so the current derived input value is used again.
actions.saves: New flora_record_changes entry; existing live flora_data row is updated where applicable.
actions.when: Only after Save changes.

actions.label: Restore this version / Restore original derived values
actions.does: Restores the selected historical correction state (or removes all overrides). The restore itself is another logged change.
actions.saves: flora_record_changes; live flora_data row where applicable.
actions.when: After confirmed restore; same stored-output rules as Save changes.

actions.label: Confirm outcome / Choose conflicting outcome
actions.does: Settles the conflicting outcomes of merged source rows by confirming the shown outcome or choosing one of the candidates.
actions.saves: flora_record_changes outcome decision, and live flora_data row where applicable.
actions.when: After success; pipeline retains this correction.

actions.label: Not a problem / Undo dismissal
actions.does: Adds a reasoned dismissal to a check finding, or reopens it for review. It does not change the scientific record.
actions.saves: flora_check_findings dismissal fields and security_events audit.
actions.when: After success; matching finding retains its dismissal across later check runs.

actions.label: Download full CSV
actions.does: Downloads the live stored dataset: last pipeline's stored rows plus subsequent published corrections.
actions.when: At request time.

actions.label: Export filtered CSV
actions.does: Downloads the current tab view with its filters. Refused if included records still lack permanent IDs.
actions.when: At request time; may differ from the full stored release.

actions.label: Preprint duplicates → Same paper, keep A / keep B
actions.does: Records which DOI should survive; the discarded DOI becomes an alternative identifier. For original-study DOIs, replications move under the kept DOI.
actions.when: Grid after refetch; stored CSV/API after next pipeline.

actions.label: Different papers — keep both / Undo ruling
actions.does: Keep both overrides automatic merging; Undo removes the explicit ruling so automatic rules apply again.
actions.saves: preprint_dedup_decisions insert/update or deletion, plus security_events audit.
actions.when: Grid after refetch; stored release after pipeline.

nodes.title: Validator Stats
nodes.summary: Shows how contributors are progressing, their judgement timing and flags, and their review tier.
inputs: validators and validation_queue joined with validation outcomes.
steps: Open the tab to fetch totals and a table of validators.
Review flagged judgements or change a validator's tier when appropriate.
saves: Only tier changes and sent messages write data.
refresh: Statistics load when the tab opens; tier cells update after success.
outputs: Contributor statistics, tier levels, flagged-judgement links and direct messages.
cautions: Tier changes affect future eligibility/weighting; they do not automatically rerun old decisions.

actions.label: Level / tier button
actions.does: Cycles the contributor tier: regular (0), trusted (1), senior (2).
actions.when: After success; later serving/consensus reads the saved tier.

actions.label: Flagged count
actions.does: Opens the list of that validator's flagged judgements, with reasons and links to the entries.
actions.when: On fetch.

actions.label: DM
actions.does: Composes and sends an in-app message to this validator.
actions.when: After Send; the recipient sees it when their inbox refreshes.

nodes.title: Admins
nodes.summary: Manages administrator accounts, their linked validator identities and the notice banner shown to validators.
steps: Trusted administrators can invite and manage other administrators.
The banner controls a notice in the signed-in validator interface.
saves: admins, auth_links, sessions, site_banner and security_events.
refresh: The account list refreshes after changes.
Validator banner fetches on sign-in and then every five minutes while visible; it catches up after a hidden interval.
outputs: Invitation/recovery email or fallback link, access changes, and a shared notice banner.
cautions: Only trusted admins can manage admin accounts; you cannot delete yourself, delete the last admin, change your own trusted status, or change your own linked validator.
The recipient chooses their own password; the inviter does not set it.

actions.label: Send invitation
actions.does: Creates an admin without a password and issues a single-use link, then attempts email delivery. If email fails the response provides a one-time fallback URL to share.
actions.when: Account exists after commit; it becomes usable after the invitee sets their password.

actions.label: Resend invitation / Send recovery link
actions.does: Issues a fresh invitation for an account without a password, or recovery for an account with one; uses its saved email address.
actions.saves: auth_links; possibly an email on an account that previously lacked one; security_events.
actions.when: After issuance; it replaces the outstanding link of that kind.

actions.label: Link / Unlink validator account
actions.does: Connects the admin to that person's validator identity for the self-approval rule. Another trusted admin must set your own link.
actions.when: After success; future decisions enforce the link.

actions.label: Trusted toggle
actions.does: Grants or removes account-management authority for another admin.
actions.when: After success.

actions.label: Remove admin
actions.does: Deletes another admin account and revokes its sessions in the same transaction.
actions.when: After confirmed deletion succeeds.

actions.label: Send to all users (banner)
actions.does: Saves and activates the banner text. This is a page notice rather than an inbox broadcast.
actions.saves: site_banner singleton row with message, active flag, editor and timestamp.
actions.when: Saved immediately; users see it on their next banner poll (up to about five minutes while visible).

actions.label: Clear banner
actions.does: Sets the banner inactive.
actions.when: After save; users remove it on their next banner poll.

nodes.title: Dashboard
nodes.summary: A read-only summary of the validation workload, completion, outcomes, disagreements and contributor activity.
inputs: Aggregated unvalidated, validated, validation_queue and validator data.
steps: Opening the tab fetches aggregates and draws charts.
Use chart selectors/controls to explore the returned data.
refresh: Fetches on opening the tab. The charts are a snapshot, not a continuous live stream.
cautions: A displayed count is current to its fetch; it does not itself run the extractor or publication pipeline.

actions.label: Open tab / chart controls
actions.does: Reads dashboard aggregates and changes chart presentation.
actions.when: On opening the tab / in the browser.

nodes.title: Pool Priority
nodes.summary: Controls which waiting records are more likely to be offered to validators. It changes assignment order, not a paper's outcome.
inputs: Proposed outcome, year range, enabled flag and priority share; the currently servable unvalidated pool.
steps: Choose the desired priority group and preview the current counts.
Click Save to apply the rule to future record selection.
saves: The single serving_config row (id = 1), including editor and timestamp.
refresh: New record requests read the saved setting. Existing claimed assignments are not replaced by this button.
Preview counts are fetched live but do not continue updating; Refresh counts recounts the current form.
outputs: A weighted/random selection rule and a preview of matching waiting records.
cautions: Reset to defaults changes the form only; press Save to persist it.
Previewing a proposed rule does not activate it.

actions.label: Enable / outcome / year / share controls
actions.does: Edits a proposed rule in the browser. Changing outcome/year refreshes the preview.
actions.when: Form changes immediately.

actions.label: Refresh counts
actions.does: Counts currently servable waiting records matching the unsaved form.
actions.when: On fetch; this is a snapshot.

actions.label: Save
actions.does: PUT /api/admin/serving-config persists the selection rule; normalizes the share and reversed year bounds.
actions.when: Future record claims use it after success.

actions.label: Reset to defaults
actions.does: Repopulates the form with default settings.
actions.when: Immediately in the form.

nodes.title: Extractor Pipeline
nodes.summary: Imports the latest candidate pairs from flora-extractor into the human-review pool. This is separate from building the final FLoRA release.
inputs: flora-extractor extracted.csv and retired_pairs.csv, previous imported snapshot, configured import thresholds.
steps: Download and compare a candidate snapshot.
Import new/changed pairs and report missing records.
Archive and retire explicitly withdrawn untouched records when the retirement policy allows it.
saves: unvalidated, record_metadata, validation_queue; extractor_snapshots; extractor_maintenance_runs; retired_records for eligible removals.
refresh: Run full sync queues work, which continues on the server if you leave the page.
History polls about every 3 seconds while a run is active and the page is visible; Refresh history requests it manually.
The nightly schedule is 02:00 UTC.
outputs: A refreshed validation pool, audited snapshot, stage counts and complete run log.
cautions: A pair missing from extracted.csv is not automatically deleted. Retirement uses the explicit withdrawn-pair list and preserves touched records.
A second active run is refused. A queued response is not completion.

actions.label: Run full sync
actions.does: POST /api/admin/maintenance/run with stage=full reserves the full maintenance routine.
actions.saves: extractor_maintenance_runs and the imported/retired data as each stage completes.
actions.when: Queued first; Entries reflect completed import transactions. Also runs nightly at 02:00 UTC.

actions.label: Refresh history
actions.does: Reloads recent run state and counts.
actions.when: On request.

actions.label: Open full log / stage details
actions.does: Fetches the chosen run's complete log and shows stage progress/results.
actions.when: At click time; an active log is refreshed when its run version changes.

nodes.title: Restricted access
nodes.summary: Routes papers that a validator could not access to a chosen person who can review them.
steps: Pick a listed record and choose a validator.
Assign or reassign it to that person's assigned-work queue.
saves: assignments row with status=open, assignee, assigning admin and timestamps; security_events audit.
refresh: The admin list reloads after assignment. The validator assignments poll runs every 30 seconds while visible and catches up after a hidden interval.
outputs: A named assignment for a restricted paper.
cautions: Assignment is not approval or publication; the assignee still has to review it.
Reassign replaces the previous assignment for that record.

actions.label: Assign / Reassign
actions.does: POST /api/admin/assign creates or replaces the record's named assignment and marks it open.
actions.when: After save; recipient receives it through assigned-work refresh.

nodes.title: Disagreements
nodes.summary: Optional review lane for disagreements between FLoRA and the Metascience Observatory. It uses its own records and two trusted/senior judgements before an admin decision.
inputs: Pinned disagreement CSV from fred-data PR #143; metadata from OpenAlex/Europe PMC; adjudication judgements.
steps: Preview and import the disagreement rows.
Two eligible people judge each row; admin reviews and approves the final answer.
Publish the approved answer into Source Records, then use the FLoRA pipeline to include it in stored outputs.
saves: adjudication.records, adjudication.judgements, adjudication.final; publication writes source_records.
refresh: The tab appears only when ADJUDICATION_ENABLED is on.
Approval changes the adjudication lane immediately; Publish updates source inputs immediately; stored public release waits for the FLoRA pipeline.
outputs: Approved disagreement decisions; new/updated Source Records; optional CSV exports.
cautions: Approve and Publish to FLoRA are separate actions.
Published answers must be withdrawn before changing the answer.
An admin cannot approve a disagreement they judged themselves.

actions.label: Preview import
actions.does: Reads the pinned source and looks up metadata; reports what an import would add/update/keep.
actions.saves: No adjudication database rows are written by the preview; metadata lookups may be cached.
actions.when: After the read/lookup completes.

actions.label: Import rows
actions.does: Adds missing rows and refreshes only rows nobody has judged; preserves judged rows and deletes nothing.
actions.when: After import succeeds; counts reload.

actions.label: Review / Next / filters
actions.does: Reads a disagreement, both judgements and any final answer/source linkage.
actions.when: On fetch.

actions.label: Approve / Save the answer
actions.does: Validates the selected original and outcome, then records the admin's final answer.
actions.when: After success; does not yet publish a source row.

actions.label: Undo approval
actions.does: Removes an approved final answer that has never been published and returns it to awaiting approval.
actions.saves: Deletes adjudication.final and changes adjudication.records status.
actions.when: After confirmation succeeds.

actions.label: Publish to FLoRA
actions.does: Checks eligibility/conflicts and creates or updates its Source Records row; records the publication identity.
actions.when: Source Records/derived grid after refresh; stored full CSV/API at next pipeline.

actions.label: Withdraw from FLoRA
actions.does: Marks the source row deleted, preserves history and returns the disagreement to approved for editing.
actions.when: Derived view after refresh; stored release at next pipeline.

actions.label: CSV exports
actions.does: Downloads the adjudication final-answer or judgement data through its dedicated export endpoint.
actions.when: At request time.

nodes.title: Messages
nodes.summary: In-app conversations with validators, including replies and messages sent to everyone. These are stored in the application inbox.
inputs: validator_messages conversations, validators, subject/body/recipient or broadcast flag.
steps: Select a conversation to read its thread, or choose + New.
Send a reply, a message to one validator, or a broadcast to all validators.
saves: validator_messages with direction, parent thread, sender, body and read flags.
refresh: Messages load when opening the tab; opening a thread marks incoming messages read by the admin.
The validator inbox polls about every 30 seconds while the inbox is open and the page is visible; messages are also fetched at validator sign-in. There is no continuous admin-thread polling.
outputs: A persisted conversation and updated unread badges.
cautions: This is the application inbox; sending here does not itself send an email.
Broadcast inserts one message for each current validator.

actions.label: Open conversation
actions.does: Reads the thread and marks its inbound messages read by the admin.
actions.when: After opening; unread badge refreshes.

actions.label: + New → Send
actions.does: Validates subject/body and inserts a message for the selected validator.
actions.when: After save; recipient sees it when inbox refreshes.

actions.label: Send to everyone / broadcast
actions.does: Creates a separate in-app message for each current validator.
actions.when: After successful send; each recipient's next inbox poll.

actions.label: Reply
actions.does: Adds an outbound reply linked to the conversation root, retaining any related judgement link.
actions.when: After successful reply; thread updates.
